bKwwuap57D2bSFhHigrX Android 17 QPR2 hasn't been pushed to AOSP as expected so we have to backport the firmware/drivers/HALs. We prepared a port to Android 17 QPR2 which we had ready to go and then it wasn't pushed. Backporting the firmware/drivers/HALs is an entirely different thing and we approach that differently than in the past since Android 17 QPR1 where we're backporting the entirety of the firmware/drivers/HALs rather than specific parts of it so it takes a bit longer but gets fully done in one update without needing to figure out what's important to backport.

Helpfull quality feedback to the team would be of course found regressions, issues, etc, as you said in essence.

(a) "Having found no issues" w/o knowing test strategy and approach, test matrix, test coverage, test duration for explorative test, etc. is not a quality feedback. But it contributes to the project by simply knowing to have more test environments and test configurations.

(b) I am following a simple test approach for contribution: start using it as my daily driver along with a timestamp for "test begin". Because I don't have a defined test duration and test campaign, I would only report regressions, issues, etc., if any at all.

I understand that not everybody sees (a) and (b) to be the same.

I understand that my reply is out of scope of this thread and my reply is not meant to further debate.

GrapheneOS They usually release quarterly updates in June/Sep/Dec/March.
Had there been some indication this time it would be released in November?

noodle_panda Yes, there were strong indications it would be released in November so we ported early and were prepared for it. Unfortunately, they didn't push it to AOSP so we'll have to backport the firmware/drivers/HALs until they release it to AOSP which will likely be in December. It's another artificial advantage for the stock Pixel OS over other OEMs and projects based on AOSP. QPR1 and QPR3 were already made exclusive to the Pixel OS and now it gets early access to QPR2 and potentially yearly releases too.
